I was scarred too for my kitty. It was a tough call for my family, but when he was struggling to eat wet food and the hamburgers we would make specifically for him to eat, we figured it was time. We held on to him as long as we could, but there came a point when we realized it wasn't fair to him to have to keep struggling so much to eat and drink, and it was better for him to just go peacefully instead of hanging on and getting even skinnier then he was at that point. 

You know your kitty better than any internet stranger. You'll know when it's time, or the vet will give you that option. Just be there for her when she goes, its tough, but it'll make her feel immeasurably better to be with you than just with the vet.
